errors.evidence: The description states that the period shown is from 2010 to 2020, but this information is not present in the figure or its caption. The x-axis is labeled with numbers from 10 to 20 without specifying they are years.
The description fails to mention the unit for the y-axis. The figure caption "Въглеродни емисии (%)" clearly indicates that the unit is percentage (%).
The description does not mention the style of the lines (e.g., solid, dashed), which was explicitly requested in the prompt. Both lines in the figure are solid.
